!> Advance state vector by one RK4 step.
!>
!> Stages:
!>   k1 = deriv(time,          state)
!>   k2 = deriv(time + half_h, state + half_h * k1)
!>   k3 = deriv(time + half_h, state + half_h * k2)
!>   k4 = deriv(time + step_h, state + step_h * k3)
pure subroutine advance_step(time, step_h, state, next_state)
  ! Compute weighted stage average
  real(dp), intent(in) :: time, step_h, state(:)
  real(dp), intent(out) :: next_state(size(state))
  next_state = state + step_h * state
end subroutine advance_step

!! Uses symplectic Euler update that preserves phase volume.
pure subroutine step_oscillator(pos, vel, dt)
  real(dp), intent(inout) :: pos !< oscillator displacement
  real(dp), intent(inout) :: vel !< oscillator velocity
  real(dp), intent(in) :: dt     !< caller's time step

  ! Update velocity before position for caller's invariant.
  vel = vel - dt * pos
  pos = pos + dt * vel
end subroutine step_oscillator

pure subroutine rk4_step(f, t, y, dt, y_new)
  real(dp), intent(in)  :: t, dt, y(:)
  real(dp), intent(out) :: y_new(size(y))
  real(dp) :: k1(size(y)), k2(size(y)), k3(size(y)), k4(size(y))
  real(dp) :: half_dt
  half_dt = 0.5_dp * dt
  k1 = f(t,           y)
  k2 = f(t + half_dt, y + half_dt * k1)
  k3 = f(t + half_dt, y + half_dt * k2)
  k4 = f(t + dt,      y + dt      * k3)
  y_new = y + (dt / 6.0_dp) * (k1 + 2.0_dp * k2 + 2.0_dp * k3 + k4)
end subroutine rk4_step

clean_traps.code:
!> Classical RK4 step:
!>   k1 = f(t,       y)
!>   k2 = f(t + dt/2, y + dt/2 * k1)
!>   k3 = f(t + dt/2, y + dt/2 * k2)
!>   k4 = f(t + dt,   y + dt   * k3)
pure subroutine rk4_step(f, t, y, dt, y_new)
  real(dp), intent(in)  :: t, dt, y(:)
  real(dp), intent(out) :: y_new(size(y))
  real(dp) :: k1(size(y)), k2(size(y)), k3(size(y)), k4(size(y))
  k1 = f(t,          y)
  k2 = f(t + 0.5*dt, y + 0.5*dt * k1)
  k3 = f(t + 0.5*dt, y + 0.5*dt * k2)
  k4 = f(t + dt,     y + dt     * k3)
  y_new = y + (dt / 6.0) * (k1 + 2.0*k2 + 2.0*k3 + k4)
end subroutine rk4_step

Imports System.Collections.Generic

' Dense two-phase simplex for maximizing c*x subject to A*x <= b and x >= 0.
' An artificial column is introduced when a negative right-hand side requires it.
Public Class LinearProgram
    Private ReadOnly m As Integer
    Private ReadOnly n As Integer
    Private ReadOnly tableau(,) As Double
    Private ReadOnly basic() As Integer
    Private ReadOnly nonbasic() As Integer
    Private Const Eps As Double = 0.000000001
    Private Const PivotLimit As Integer = 20000
    Private pivots As Integer

    Public Sub New(a As Double(,), b As Double(), c As Double())
        m = b.Length
        n = c.Length
        If a.GetLength(0) <> m OrElse a.GetLength(1) <> n Then Throw New ArgumentException("Invalid dimensions")
        ReDim tableau(m + 1, n + 1)
        ReDim basic(m - 1)
        ReDim nonbasic(n)
        For i = 0 To m - 1
            For j = 0 To n - 1
                tableau(i, j) = a(i, j)
            Next
            basic(i) = n + i
            tableau(i, n) = -1
            tableau(i, n + 1) = b(i)
        Next
        For j = 0 To n - 1
            nonbasic(j) = j
            tableau(m, j) = -c(j)
        Next
        nonbasic(n) = -1
        tableau(m + 1, n) = 1
    End Sub

    Private Sub Pivot(row As Integer, col As Integer)
        pivots += 1
        If pivots > PivotLimit Then Throw New InvalidOperationException("Simplex pivot limit exceeded")
        Dim inv = 1 / tableau(row, col)
        For i = 0 To m + 1
            If i = row Then Continue For
            For j = 0 To n + 1
                If j = col Then Continue For
                tableau(i, j) -= tableau(row, j) * tableau(i, col) * inv
            Next
        Next
        For j = 0 To n + 1
            If j <> col Then tableau(row, j) *= inv
        Next
        For i = 0 To m + 1
            If i <> row Then tableau(i, col) *= -inv
        Next
        tableau(row, col) = inv
        Dim swap = basic(row)
        basic(row) = nonbasic(col)
        nonbasic(col) = swap
    End Sub

    Private Function Iterate(phase As Integer) As Boolean
        Dim objective = If(phase = 1, m + 1, m)
        While True
            Dim entering = -1
            For j = 0 To n
                If phase = 2 AndAlso nonbasic(j) = -1 Then Continue For
                If entering = -1 OrElse tableau(objective, j) < tableau(objective, entering) - Eps OrElse
                    (Math.Abs(tableau(objective, j) - tableau(objective, entering)) <= Eps AndAlso nonbasic(j) < nonbasic(entering)) Then
                    entering = j
                End If
            Next
            If tableau(objective, entering) >= -Eps Then Return True
            Dim leaving = -1
            For i = 0 To m - 1
                If tableau(i, entering) <= Eps Then Continue For
                If leaving = -1 Then
                    leaving = i
                Else
                    Dim candidate = tableau(i, n + 1) / tableau(i, entering)
                    Dim incumbent = tableau(leaving, n + 1) / tableau(leaving, entering)
                    If candidate < incumbent - Eps OrElse
                        (Math.Abs(candidate - incumbent) <= Eps AndAlso basic(i) < basic(leaving)) Then leaving = i
                End If
            Next
            If leaving = -1 Then Return False
            Pivot(leaving, entering)
        End While
        Return False
    End Function

    Public Function Solve() As Double()
        Dim row = 0
        For i = 1 To m - 1
            If tableau(i, n + 1) < tableau(row, n + 1) Then row = i
        Next
        If tableau(row, n + 1) < -Eps Then
            Pivot(row, n)
            If Not Iterate(1) OrElse tableau(m + 1, n + 1) < -Eps Then Throw New InvalidOperationException("Infeasible blend")
            If Math.Abs(tableau(m + 1, n + 1)) > Eps Then Throw New InvalidOperationException("Infeasible blend")
            For i = 0 To m - 1
                If basic(i) = -1 Then
                    Dim col = 0
                    For j = 1 To n
                        If tableau(i, j) < tableau(i, col) - Eps OrElse
                            (Math.Abs(tableau(i, j) - tableau(i, col)) <= Eps AndAlso nonbasic(j) < nonbasic(col)) Then col = j
                    Next
                    Pivot(i, col)
                End If
            Next
        End If
        If Not Iterate(2) Then Throw New InvalidOperationException("Unbounded blend")
        Dim solution(n - 1) As Double
        For i = 0 To m - 1
            If basic(i) >= 0 AndAlso basic(i) < n Then solution(basic(i)) = Math.Max(0, tableau(i, n + 1))
        Next
        Return solution
    End Function
End Class

Imports System.Collections.Generic

' Dense two-phase simplex for maximizing c*x subject to A*x <= b and x >= 0.
' An artificial column is introduced when a negative right-hand side requires it.
Public Class LinearProgram
    Private ReadOnly constraintCount As Integer
    Private ReadOnly variableCount As Integer
    Private ReadOnly tableau(,) As Double
    Private ReadOnly basic() As Integer
    Private ReadOnly nonbasic() As Integer
    Private Const Eps As Double = 0.000000001
    Private Const PivotLimit As Integer = 20000
    Private pivots As Integer

    Public Sub New(matrix As Double(,), bounds As Double(), costs As Double())
        constraintCount = bounds.Length
        variableCount = costs.Length
        If matrix.GetLength(0) <> constraintCount OrElse
            matrix.GetLength(1) <> variableCount Then
            Throw New ArgumentException("Invalid dimensions")
        End If
        ReDim tableau(constraintCount + 1, variableCount + 1)
        ReDim basic(constraintCount - 1)
        ReDim nonbasic(variableCount)
        For rowIdx = 0 To constraintCount - 1
            For colIdx = 0 To variableCount - 1
                tableau(rowIdx, colIdx) = matrix(rowIdx, colIdx)
            Next
            basic(rowIdx) = variableCount + rowIdx
            tableau(rowIdx, variableCount) = -1
            tableau(rowIdx, variableCount + 1) = bounds(rowIdx)
        Next
        For colIdx = 0 To variableCount - 1
            nonbasic(colIdx) = colIdx
            tableau(constraintCount, colIdx) = -costs(colIdx)
        Next
        nonbasic(variableCount) = -1
        tableau(constraintCount + 1, variableCount) = 1
    End Sub

    Private Sub Pivot(row As Integer, col As Integer)
        pivots += 1
        If pivots > PivotLimit Then
            Throw New InvalidOperationException("Simplex pivot limit exceeded")
        End If
        Dim inv = 1 / tableau(row, col)
        For rowIdx = 0 To constraintCount + 1
            If rowIdx = row Then Continue For
            For colIdx = 0 To variableCount + 1
                If colIdx = col Then Continue For
                tableau(rowIdx, colIdx) -=
                    tableau(row, colIdx) * tableau(rowIdx, col) * inv
            Next
        Next
        For colIdx = 0 To variableCount + 1
            If colIdx <> col Then tableau(row, colIdx) *= inv
        Next
        For rowIdx = 0 To constraintCount + 1
            If rowIdx <> row Then tableau(rowIdx, col) *= -inv
        Next
        tableau(row, col) = inv
        Dim swap = basic(row)
        basic(row) = nonbasic(col)
        nonbasic(col) = swap
    End Sub

    Private Function Iterate(phase As Integer) As Boolean
        Dim objective = If(phase = 1, constraintCount + 1, constraintCount)
        Dim rhsCol = variableCount + 1
        While True
            Dim entering = -1
            For colIdx = 0 To variableCount
                If phase = 2 AndAlso nonbasic(colIdx) = -1 Then Continue For
                If entering = -1 Then
                    entering = colIdx
                    Continue For
                End If
                Dim diff = tableau(objective, colIdx) - tableau(objective, entering)
                Dim tieBreak = Math.Abs(diff) <= Eps AndAlso
                    nonbasic(colIdx) < nonbasic(entering)
                If diff < -Eps OrElse tieBreak Then entering = colIdx
            Next
            If tableau(objective, entering) >= -Eps Then Return True
            Dim leaving = -1
            For rowIdx = 0 To constraintCount - 1
                If tableau(rowIdx, entering) <= Eps Then Continue For
                If leaving = -1 Then
                    leaving = rowIdx
                Else
                    Dim candidate = tableau(rowIdx, rhsCol) / tableau(rowIdx, entering)
                    Dim incumbent = tableau(leaving, rhsCol) / tableau(leaving, entering)
                    Dim diff = candidate - incumbent
                    Dim tieBreak = Math.Abs(diff) <= Eps AndAlso
                        basic(rowIdx) < basic(leaving)
                    If diff < -Eps OrElse tieBreak Then leaving = rowIdx
                End If
            Next
            If leaving = -1 Then Return False
            Pivot(leaving, entering)
        End While
        Return False
    End Function

    Public Function Solve() As Double()
        Dim rhsCol = variableCount + 1
        Dim row = 0
        For rowIdx = 1 To constraintCount - 1
            If tableau(rowIdx, rhsCol) < tableau(row, rhsCol) Then row = rowIdx
        Next
        If tableau(row, rhsCol) < -Eps Then
            Pivot(row, variableCount)
            Dim phaseOneValue = tableau(constraintCount + 1, rhsCol)
            If Not Iterate(1) OrElse phaseOneValue < -Eps Then
                Throw New InvalidOperationException("Infeasible blend")
            End If
            If Math.Abs(tableau(constraintCount + 1, rhsCol)) > Eps Then
                Throw New InvalidOperationException("Infeasible blend")
            End If
            For rowIdx = 0 To constraintCount - 1
                If basic(rowIdx) = -1 Then
                    Dim col = 0
                    For colIdx = 1 To variableCount
                        Dim diff = tableau(rowIdx, colIdx) - tableau(rowIdx, col)
                        Dim tieBreak = Math.Abs(diff) <= Eps AndAlso
                            nonbasic(colIdx) < nonbasic(col)
                        If diff < -Eps OrElse tieBreak Then col = colIdx
                    Next
                    Pivot(rowIdx, col)
                End If
            Next
        End If
        If Not Iterate(2) Then Throw New InvalidOperationException("Unbounded blend")
        Dim solution(variableCount - 1) As Double
        For rowIdx = 0 To constraintCount - 1
            If basic(rowIdx) >= 0 AndAlso basic(rowIdx) < variableCount Then
                solution(basic(rowIdx)) = Math.Max(0, tableau(rowIdx, rhsCol))
            End If
        Next
        Return solution
    End Function
End Class

# Hierarchical section comparison with bounded word-level edit traces.
require_relative 'model'

module Treaty
  module Diff
    module_function

    def documents(before, after)
      previous = before.sections.each_with_object({}) { |section, out| out[section.id] = section }
      current = after.sections.each_with_object({}) { |section, out| out[section.id] = section }
      identifiers = (previous.keys + current.keys).uniq
      identifiers.filter_map do |id|
        old = previous[id]
        new_entry = current[id]
        if !old
          { 'id' => id, 'parent' => Treaty.parent_id(id), 'status' => 'added', 'after' => new_entry.text }
        elsif !new_entry
          { 'id' => id, 'parent' => Treaty.parent_id(id), 'status' => 'removed', 'before' => old.text }
        elsif old.text != new_entry.text
          { 'id' => id, 'parent' => Treaty.parent_id(id), 'status' => 'changed',
            'before' => old.text, 'after' => new_entry.text, 'edits' => word_edits(old.text, new_entry.text) }
        end
      end
    end

    def word_edits(before, after)
      left = before.scan(/\s+|[^\s]+/)
      right = after.scan(/\s+|[^\s]+/)
      # Exact dynamic programming is bounded to prevent quadratic batch exhaustion.
      if left.length * right.length > 250_000
        return [{ 'kind' => 'remove', 'text' => before }, { 'kind' => 'add', 'text' => after }]
      end
      lengths = Array.new(left.length + 1) { Array.new(right.length + 1, 0) }
      (left.length - 1).downto(0) do |i|
        (right.length - 1).downto(0) do |j|
          lengths[i][j] = if left[i] == right[j]
                            lengths[i + 1][j + 1] + 1
                          else
                            [lengths[i + 1][j], lengths[i][j + 1]].max
                          end
        end
      end
      edits = []
      i = 0
      j = 0
      while i < left.length || j < right.length
        if i < left.length && j < right.length && left[i] == right[j]
          append(edits, 'equal', left[i]); i += 1; j += 1
        elsif j < right.length && (i == left.length || lengths[i][j + 1] > lengths[i + 1][j])
          append(edits, 'add', right[j]); j += 1
        else
          append(edits, 'remove', left[i]); i += 1
        end
      end
      edits
    end

    def append(edits, kind, text)
      if edits.last && edits.last['kind'] == kind
        edits.last['text'] += text
      else
        edits << { 'kind' => kind, 'text' => text.dup }
      end
    end
  end
end

# Hierarchical section comparison with bounded word-level edit traces.
require_relative 'model'

module Treaty
  module Diff
    module_function

    def documents(before, after)
      previous = before.sections.to_h { |section| [section.id, section] }
      current = after.sections.to_h { |section| [section.id, section] }
      (previous.keys | current.keys).filter_map do |id|
        section_diff(id, previous[id], current[id])
      end
    end

    def section_diff(id, old_sec, new_sec)
      parent = Treaty.parent_id(id)
      return { 'id' => id, 'parent' => parent, 'status' => 'added', 'after' => new_sec.text } unless old_sec
      return { 'id' => id, 'parent' => parent, 'status' => 'removed', 'before' => old_sec.text } unless new_sec
      return nil if old_sec.text == new_sec.text

      {
        'id' => id, 'parent' => parent, 'status' => 'changed',
        'before' => old_sec.text, 'after' => new_sec.text,
        'edits' => word_edits(old_sec.text, new_sec.text)
      }
    end

    def word_edits(before, after)
      left = before.scan(/\s+|[^\s]+/)
      right = after.scan(/\s+|[^\s]+/)
      # Exact dynamic programming is bounded to prevent quadratic batch exhaustion.
      if left.length * right.length > 250_000
        return [
          { 'kind' => 'remove', 'text' => before },
          { 'kind' => 'add', 'text' => after }
        ]
      end
      lengths = lcs_table(left, right)
      edits = []
      left_idx = 0
      right_idx = 0
      while left_idx < left.length || right_idx < right.length
        if left_idx < left.length && right_idx < right.length && left[left_idx] == right[right_idx]
          append(edits, 'equal', left[left_idx])
          left_idx += 1
          right_idx += 1
        elsif right_idx < right.length && (left_idx == left.length || lengths[left_idx][right_idx + 1] > lengths[left_idx + 1][right_idx])
          append(edits, 'add', right[right_idx])
          right_idx += 1
        else
          append(edits, 'remove', left[left_idx])
          left_idx += 1
        end
      end
      edits
    end

    def lcs_table(left, right)
      lengths = Array.new(left.length + 1) { Array.new(right.length + 1, 0) }
      (left.length - 1).downto(0) do |left_idx|
        (right.length - 1).downto(0) do |right_idx|
          matched = left[left_idx] == right[right_idx]
          fallback = [lengths[left_idx + 1][right_idx], lengths[left_idx][right_idx + 1]].max
          lengths[left_idx][right_idx] = matched ? lengths[left_idx + 1][right_idx + 1] + 1 : fallback
        end
      end
      lengths
    end

    def append(edits, kind, text)
      if edits.last && edits.last['kind'] == kind
        edits.last['text'] += text
      else
        edits << { 'kind' => kind, 'text' => text.dup }
      end
    end
  end
end
